messages:
Maya R.: Customer (org: org_98765) says console shows 100 trial credits but API /v1/billing/usage returns 0 and token billing keeps accruing. Customer attached screenshots and says they started dev tests yesterday.
Paul T.: thx. can you paste the org id + sample curl they used? also need a request id from the API response if any.
Maya R.: org id is org_98765. sample curl from customer:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-sample" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?org=org_98765
```
Response snippet they got: ```{"used_tokens":0,"credits_balance":0}``` despite console showing 100 credits.
Simon K.: pinging billing team. initial thought: promo credit applied to billing account but not linked to org in entitlement service, or UI reading from promo ledger vs API reading from billing ledger. I'll check promo-sync logs for last 24h.
Lina S.: adding repro steps: I called /v1/billing/status with our infra key and saw console_balance:100 for org_98765 but billing_ledger shows 0 entries. Screenshot in thread.
billing-bot: Promo-sync job completed: promo-sync-2026-02-26T02:12Z status=success processed=312 promos. no errors logged for org_98765.
Paul T.: can we get the customer's API request-id headers (x-rdw-req-id) and the timestamp? need to trace through gateway and entitlement service.
Maya R.: forwarded headers: x-rdw-req-id: r-0a1b2c3, timestamp: 2026-02-26T14:03:22Z. Customer available for a short window if we need live keys.
Simon K.: traced r-0a1b2c3 — gateway shows request forwarded to billing-v2 and entitlement-v1. entitlement-v1 returned "entitlements": [] for org_98765 at 14:03:22Z. So entitlement lookup failed to include promo credit binding.
Lina S.: looking at entitlement DB entry: promo_bindings table shows promo_code=TRIAL2026 bound to account acct_453 but org mapping points to acct_999. looks like normalization script failed to map org->account for this batch.
Paul T.: hypothesis: recent change in org normalization (slug->id) caused some promos to be attached to legacy acct ids. quick fix: run a targeted sync for org_98765 and rebind promo to acct_453, then trigger entitlement cache invalidation.
ops-oncall: I'll run the targeted sync now (will take ~5m). Executing: `./promo_admin rebind --org org_98765 --promo TRIAL2026`
ops-oncall: rebind complete. invalidated entitlement cache key ent:org_98765
billing-bot: Entitlement change event emitted: ent-update-org_98765 id=e-55b2f
Simon K.: re-checked entitlement-v1 for org_98765 — it now returns entitlements: ["TRIAL2026:100credits"].
Maya R.: relayed to customer — they re-ran their API call and now see `{"used_tokens":0,"credits_balance":100}`. customer confirms billing no longer charging tokens against their card. :tada: 
Paul T.: root cause: org normalization mismatch in promo ingestion pipeline which left some promos bound to legacy account ids. mitigation: add integrity check to promo ingestion and a daily reconciliation job; engineering will open a PR and schedule reconciler.
Simon K.: filed ENG-2031 with details and steps to reproduce. assigned to me. ETA for PR + rollout: 2d.
Maya R.: thanks team — customer updated to say they're unblocked. closing ticket after follow-up email and apply small goodwill credit for inconvenience.
Lina S.: will follow up on the PR review and reconciliation schedule.
Paul T.: nice work, ops. :thumbsup:
